description: Batched finalization transcript vectors (docs/pool-keys-v4.md §6–§9). transcript is the fixed L_F-word calldata finalizeEpoch streams (decimal field elements); dealers carry the accepted contributions' coefficients (key-major, t per key) and the commitmentsHash the contract stores; shareCommitments[j][i] is D_j,i for committee member i+1 (n per key here, identity (0,1) beyond in the transcript); shareRoots[j] is the keccak Merkle root of key j's leaves; challenge = keccak(eid12 ‖ domain ‖ anchor) mod p; transcriptCommitment = Σ ρ^(q+1)·w[q].
layout: [0,N) participant indexes (0 for rows ≥ a); [N,2N) contribution hashes (0 for rows ≥ a); key j at 2N + j·(2+2N): P[j].x, P[j].y, D[j][0].x, D[j][0].y, …, D[j][N−1].x, D[j][N−1].y ((0,1) for i ≥ n)
digest: R = H(0, I[0..N), h[0..N)); B_j = H(1, j, P[j].x, P[j].y, D[j][0].x, …); T = H(2, eid, t, n, a, K, L_F, R, B_0, …, B_(K−1)); H = Poseidon MultiHash (16-input chunks)
